_why: Owner policy 2026-10-11, verbatim: "nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free."

The repo's OpenRouter key now has a $0 monthly credit limit. Every model call in this repo goes through loop/llm_router.py, which sends ONLY the models below, in this order, with a per-request max price of 0, and fails loudly if OpenRouter ever reports a non-zero cost.
There is no paid fallback. A refused key is the named stop OPENROUTER_KEY_DISABLED_OR_INVALID; no free model answering is OPENROUTER_NO_FREE_MODEL.

Refresh: fetch https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (no key needed), require named :free text models priced 0/0 with >=32k context, then curate about 3-5 from script benchmark quality and route-ledger evidence, not model count. Drop small, consistently empty, or retired models. Date each why and snapshot_date. Run loop/bench_free_models.py with --reasoning default to measure the production 2000-token reasoning budget.

Owner 2026-11-02, verbatim: "free models first, claude last -- but let's be picky about which free models, like gemini and good ones." Supersedes the 2026-10-12 subscription-first ruling. Gemini free tier first, curated OpenRouter second, Claude subscription last. Ledger standing() ranks within tiers; preferences never cross tiers. Draft validation rejections are excluded from that draft's subsequent calls.

Bench 2026-10-12 (research/free_model_bench/2026-10-12.md): nemotron-3-super, -ultra, -3.5-lightning and dots-3-note spent the whole 16,000-token max_tokens on hidden reasoning and returned empty text (finish_reason=length). reasoning_max_tokens caps that thinking (OpenRouter `reasoning.max_tokens`, the form every listed model accepts; `effort` is not - ultra takes only high/medium - and `exclude` still spends the budget); max_tokens 24000 fits a ~1,500-word script plus that budget. loop/llm_router.py reasoning_problems() pins the shape.

2026-11-02 measured refresh: research/free_model_bench/2026-11-02.json/.md. All 9 candidates were tested on two current queued topics with the production request body. No full pass; choose the best serving script candidates plus a dense 31B capacity alternative, drop two-empty-answer Dots and small/retired models. The OpenRouter key reported limit 0; no paid fallback.

seeded_from_bench.why: 2026-11-02: existing seed_ledger() merged actual benchmark verdicts with genuine history; ranking records standing() for the selected OpenRouter roster at this seed. Per-model why fields explain selection using full benchmark quality, not answer count. Synthetic test events were removed. Gemini remains the first tier regardless of cross-provider standing.

gemini_route.why: 2026-11-02: AI Studio key, FREE TIER ONLY, never enable billing. Current Google pricing https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.md lists free input/output for these models: 3.8 is its most intelligent Flash, then 3.6; 2.5 Flash (best 12 Oct script bench) precedes the weaker 3.5 Flash-Lite. Ledger measures quality within this tier. Pro 3.1 excluded: no free API tier. Pro 2.5 removed after two HTTP 404 responses in the 2 Nov bench. 403/404/429 falls through. DATA RULE: free-tier prompts may improve Google products; channel scripts only, never confidential data (LP names, deal terms). Current two-topic bench: 2.5 Flash wrote 2047/1357 words but failed validation; 3.8/3.6 had service errors, and Lite remained structurally invalid. No full pass is claimed; current capability order seeds the tier, with ledger measurements applied within it.
